body:
## What Makes Sector P Important

[Sector P](/faisal-town-p-block/), also presented as The Caladan, is currently one of the most visible [Faisal Town Phase 2](/faisal-town-phase-2/) offers on this website. It is promoted with discounted full-payment pricing and development charges included in the listed cost of plot.

The main buyer attraction is straightforward: clear plot sizes, visible price plan, master plan review, and direct availability checks before booking.

- [Sector P landing page](/faisal-town-p-block/)
- [Faisal Town Phase 2](/faisal-town-phase-2/)

## Available Plot Sizes

The listed Sector P sizes include 5.56 Marla, 8 Marla, 10.89 Marla, 14.22 Marla, 1 Kanal, and 2 Kanal options. Buyers should confirm which specific sizes and plot locations are available at the time of inquiry.

Sector P is presented here as a full-payment offer, not an installment plan. Buyers seeking installments should ask separately about other available sectors.

## Before You Book

Ask for current inventory, plot location, total payable amount, registration fee, additional location charges, payment recipient details, and booking documentation before making a payment.

If you are overseas, request a video consultation and document checklist. It is better to verify first than to rush into a payment based only on a screenshot.

- Current plot number and location
- Full payable amount
- Registration fee and location charges
- Payment recipient and receipt process

> Sector P is presented here as a full-payment offer, not an installment plan.

## Questions to Ask Before Token Money

Ask whether the plot is available right now, which plot number is being offered, how it appears on the Sector P plan, and whether the quoted amount includes all development charges and location premiums.

Also ask for the exact payment recipient, receipt procedure, booking form process and a written summary of the offer. A buyer should be able to trace the full transaction path before making any payment.

- Is this exact plot available today?
- Is the price full-payment or another arrangement?
- Are location charges included?
- What proof will I receive after payment?

- [Sector P prices and availability](/faisal-town-p-block/)

## When to Choose Another Phase 2 Sector

Sector P may not fit every buyer. If you need installments, a different budget range, a different map position or a specific sector plan, compare Sector S, Sector T, Sector R, Sector O and Overseas Enclave before deciding.

The best result is not simply the lowest price. The better choice is the plot whose location, payment terms, documentation and timing match the buyer's actual purpose.

- [Faisal Town Phase 2 sectors](/faisal-town-phase-2/)
- [Plots for sale](/plots-for-sale-faisal-town-islamabad/)
